title: ROC assistant chat, AdSense-ready privacy policy, contact details
changes: ROC is for signed-in members: the Ask ROC button opens the chat for members and takes everyone else to the game checker page, where ROC sits inside the page with Sign in / Create a free account
ROC knows our games (checker list and 500 Steam games), gaming platforms and devices (CMS > Gaming platforms) and products; it recommends gear only when asked

ROC, the new assistant: an Ask ROC chat on every page (also the PHP pages) for any gaming question in English or Roman Urdu: the Can I run it check with the checker list (GTA 5, Valorant, Cyberpunk and 500 Steam games), gear picks from our products, gaming history, esports, consoles and news (web search for new things)
ROC can hear (microphone, English or Urdu), read pictures (for example a screenshot of the PC specs) and read its answers aloud
ROC answers gaming only: other topics get a polite no, bad words and adult messages are blocked
Chats are saved with the member account (no names, emails or phone numbers in the text) and shown in CMS > ROC assistant with who asked (on/off, daily AI limit, search, delete)
The old assistant button (a fixed script) is gone
Privacy policy: Google AdSense and cookie opt-out, the ROC chat, contact details

Contact details on the website: contact@runonconsole.com, phone and address in the footer (clickable), on the Contact page and in the Organization schema; form messages go to contact@runonconsole.com (cli-contact-info.php for the saved menu)
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/, unzip it, then run the installers listed in the deploy message.
